articles.summary: GUANGZHOU, China, Jan. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Viomi Technology Co., Ltd (“Viomi” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: VIOT), a leading technology company for home water solutions in China, today provided an update on its previously announced share repurchase program.
articles.title: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd Provides Update on Share Repurchase Program
